text:
Alex K: Quick heads-up — I'm at SFO and the flight's delayed. Need someone to take primary 22:00->02:00 tonight. I can be reachable but would prefer not to be primary during the overnight deploy window. Who can swap?

Maya P: I can take primary 22:00–02:00 but would like a short shadow for the first 30m — I have a deploy at 23:15 I'd rather not be the sole responder for.

Diego R: I can shadow Maya as secondary for the first hour. Alex, do you want me to monitor the edge cache metrics during the handoff? @Maya P

oncall-bot: Rotation swap requested by Alex K.
Status: pending confirmation
Current primary: Alex K
Proposed primary: Maya P
Actions: Maya P can confirm with `ack` or use `/rotate confirm`.

Alex K: ack from me — please proceed. Pager is forwardable from the PD console. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff (see id: rb-007)

Sam L: Short checklist before swap:
- Forward pager in PD (confirm screenshot)
- Update rotation calendar (ops-rotation)
- Pin latency/error dashboards in #oncall-dash
- Post visible handoff note in this thread
If any customer-impacting alerts fire, tag #incidents and @Sam L.

Maya P: I'm doing the swap now. Forwarding pager...

Maya P: Pager forwarding done — verified in PD UI. I have pager now. :white_check_mark:
Handoff checklist (short):
- Pager: forwarded
- Dashboards: pinned
- Known risk: embeddings-queue-lag alert (rb-007)

Diego R: I'll watch the edge cache and embeddings queue for 30m. Noted the previous cache-stall at ~21:50.

Maya P: Quick runbook steps I'm running now:
```
# verify pager assignment
pd whoami --user maya
# check last 15m of error budget
curl -s https://telemetry.internal/api/errbudget?svc=api | jq '.last_15m'
# enable canary route
rcli routes update --name gen-prod --canary 200 --duration 5m
```

oncall-bot: Pager forwarding event logged (evt id: pf-202309). Pager owner: Maya P. Rotation calendar entry updated by oncall-bot.

Alex K: Thanks. Diego — if you see cache-stall spike >500ms tail, escalate to Maya and tag @Sam L.

Diego R: Will do. Standing by.

Maya P: Also setting a temporary fallback policy in case latency spikes. Plan: if 95p latency > 800ms for 2m, route to smaller model variant.

Sam L: Sounds good. Toggle policy flag: console -> Projects -> prod -> Routing -> fallback. Threshold agreed.

oncall-bot: Policy change recorded by Maya P (pc-982). Canary started at 23:02:12: 200rps for 5m. No significant error increase observed.

Alex K: Appreciate it all — I'm going to the gate but will keep phone open. Please call if pager fires, otherwise leave incident noise here. :airplane:

Maya P: Thanks Alex. Diego and Sam — ping if anything unusual. I'll update this thread if we escalate.

Sam L: :thumbsup:

Maya P: Final confirm — I'm primary from 22:00–02:00. I'll hand back in this thread when Alex is back on primary or when rotation calendar shows him as primary.

oncall-bot: Swap completed and logged. If you need to revert use `/rotate revert <timestamp>`.
